title: Project-scoped repository binding
description: A repository coordinate resolved from a Ground Control project (ADR-028 project scoping), replacing caller-supplied repoOwner/repoName/baseBranch for privileged GitHub side effects. The workflow resolves the binding once via the resolveRepositoryBinding activity and passes it to every GitHub activity, so a caller authorized for one project cannot redirect the worker credential at another repository.

x-ground-control-invariants.description: Repository-binding records tagged x-gc-record serialize to documents valid against this schema.
